title: Design and plan Medusa datapack boss for Minecraft 26.1.2
objective: Produce an implementation-ready design and implementation plan for a Minecraft Java 26.1.2 datapack-driven Medusa dungeon and boss encounter with a temple-to-underground labyrinth, gaze-based petrification, multiplayer rescue, three combat phases, renewable rematches, a charged Medusa Staff reward, and a swappable optional resource-pack visual layer.
acceptance_criteria: The design targets Minecraft Java 26.1.2 and keeps gameplay datapack-driven and multiplayer-safe
The dungeon progression is a fixed critical route through a surface temple, underground labyrinth, inner lair, and final arena, with optional branches and three simple Gorgon-themed puzzles

The Medusa encounter implements gaze-based progressive petrification, a telegraphed Gorgon Gaze, full-statue suffocation, teammate shell-breaking rescue, three escalating phases, restrained serpent attacks, and reliable failure/reset behavior
The Golden Gorgon Eye uses the approved black-and-gold custom-head texture and remains a persistent ritual key rather than a consumed one-time item
The reward loop defines Medusa's Heart, Gorgon Scales, Serpent Fangs, vanilla treasure, and a Medusa Staff with 64 charges, scale-based recharging, channelled petrification, and 4-charge Stone Spikes
Repeat Medusa fights use the approved Golden Gorgon Eye plus offering ritual while dungeon enemies and traps can reset independently

The visual design uses the selected dark green Medusa skin as an under-layer with a custom serpent body, snake hair, claws, glowing eyes, and breakable stone shell details while the resource pack remains optional for gameplay correctness
Architecture boundaries, multiplayer state, cleanup/failsafes, testing scenarios, and asset-swapping boundaries are explicit
The written spec and later implementation plan contain no TODO/TBD placeholders or contradictory requirements and are ready for implementation after human review
